mechanism: Estradiol induces lamotrigine glucuronidation via UGT1A4, reducing lamotrigine plasma concentrations by 40-60% and potentially decreasing seizure control.
action: Monitor lamotrigine levels and seizure control; may require lamotrigine dose increase of 50-100% when adding estradiol-containing contraceptives; lamotrigine levels may increase again during hormone-free intervals.
